versions.content: Semantics of DiagnosticServiceDataMapping . parame- terElementAccess A reference to given DiagnosticParameterElement may need more than one reference in order to be able to resolve the element position in nested array-shaped DiagnosticParameterElement s. Therefore the meta-class DiagnosticParameterElementAccess utilizes the fol- lowing references: • contextElement covers the ability to provide references to array elements in nested array-shaped DiagnosticParameterElement s • targetElement defines the reference to the final target DiagnosticParam- eterElement .
